comments.author: Edgedemon
comments.body:
technically not true, if you have one alt or friend hold the map for you, you can get another copy right away, that is the way to farm the infamous art 8 maps.

you do however need to report to someone ( anyone works but you get less fame this way) before you can "discover" it again.

so you could stock on these and:

discover -> report in athens(just across the place) -> discover again -> rinse and repeat until boredom

which may theoretically still be faster than collecting the berries, and give more adv exp.
